author: Ango
body:
Name: angomango21 / new username (ango)

Reason I was banned: I was banned for using the hack Killaura by Gold rank BlueberryWaffle7 on January 25th 2014

Reason why I should be unbanned: I really regret that first day of using this hack it was fun to use and I had no idea what would happen if I was caught but yes now I know and please I will never do this again I have removed the hack from my launcher last year it has no place in my minecraft history anymore and I'm proud for it to be gone. After waiting a long year and almost 2 years I think I have learnt my lesson not to hack ever again, and I promise this.
